close_reason: Added #[serde(rename = "reportingUA")] to Mdn::reporting_ua in jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs; updated unit test and parse_mdns JSON key in common/mod.rs
description: Mdn::reporting_ua with #[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")] serializes to reportingUa (lowercase a). draft-ietf-jmap-mdn-17 §2 specifies the wire name as reportingUA (uppercase A). Confirmed in spec: 'reportingUA: String|null Name of the MUA'. Trigger: any client that reads the spec and sends {"reportingUA": ...} will have the field silently dropped (serde ignores unknown camelCase fields). Fix: add #[serde(rename = "reportingUA")] to the reporting_ua field in jmap-mail-types/src/mdn.rs.
title: reportingUA wire name: camelCase gives reportingUa but spec says reportingUA
